I couldn’t believe this. I am speechless. She was old, looks like I needed to say everything by myself, but I said in the end ,,you are the doctor,you need to tell me what do I need to do,please give me an advice,,
I don’t know. I never had a worst doctor visiting experience.

I cannot call this old lady a doctor. Sorry for that.
